documented_behavior:
GitHub's April 2022 security alert describes an attack campaign that abused stolen OAuth user tokens issued to third-party integrators (Heroku and Travis CI) to download private repository data from victim organizations.
GitHub reported that a compromised AWS API key used against npm infrastructure was obtained after private repositories were downloaded via a stolen OAuth token.
mapping_assumptions:
AIT does not replay GitHub's production OAuth telemetry. This fixture models private-repository download beyond a declared public-metadata allowlist as a synthetic /reconstruction/excess-scope/private-repo path.
Discovery of cloud credentials inside cloned private content is represented with the synthetic sensitive marker aws_access_key_id (value redacted / reconstructed placeholder only).
Mutated-phase addition of the private-repo path models integrator token abuse relative to a constrained baseline integration surface.
